responsibility: Defines the M32R-specific RTL operand predicates used by the machine description during instruction matching and expansion. These predicates classify legal registers, immediates, symbolic addresses, compare forms, call operands, extend operands, move sources/destinations, block-move sizes, and short versus long instructions, encoding M32R-specific restrictions such as auto-increment address forms, carry-bit comparisons, seth/add3 eligibility, and constant forms that particular m32r.md patterns rely on.
